description:
User approved the fz-9x7.37 page in Binary Handling's session ("fz-9x7.37 approved"; "proceed"). Settled: one site table per program (processes must be cheap); counters run in production (a compiler option to omit them is a possible later step); fixtures are re-expressed by intent, never re-blessed. Agreed with GC: .37 lands in full before the fz-9x7.11 collector steps. Builder: Binary Handling.

Step 3 of 4. Deleted: the five inline counters, the per-kind stored fields and alloc_count. Today the inline counters cost 15 instructions per allocation (Bugs and Cleanup's sum listing; Binary Handling's <<byte>> 78 vs 63).

comments.text:
Found by Binary Handling while building fz-9x7.37.1 (#776); added to this step's deletion and review list:
1. Heap::record_external_alloc (runtime/src/heap/imp.rs) has no caller; delete it here.
2. The site counts include the two entry closures the scheduler builds before a process resets its own stats. So 'heap_alloc_stats is a sum over sites' shifts the closure figures by that scaffolding. This moves pins: it goes on the per-fixture list for the user before fz-9x7.37.4.

title: heap_alloc_stats is a sum over sites
